claims.statement: Every cyclic subgroup TPP triple in a finite 2-group of nilpotency class at most three has factor-order product at most the group order.
claims.scope: No group-order bound or catalogue input.

claims.statement: The same bound holds in every finite nilpotent group whose Sylow 2-subgroup has class at most three.
claims.scope: Combines the new 2-group theorem with the previously reviewed unrestricted odd-prime theorem.

claims.statement: If P=<a,b> has class at most three, c lies in abPhi(P), and Phi(P)=<a²,b²,c²>, then Phi(P) is powerful.
claims.scope: No TPP or cyclic-order equality is needed for this structural lemma.

claims.statement: The constructed class-three group of order4096 has a nonpowerful Frattini subgroup, so the new theorem covers a group outside the previous hereditary-powerful-Frattini sufficient class.
claims.scope: An exact single presentation witness, not a TPP violation or a census.

retained_primary_input: The exact Lubotzky–Mann powerful-group structure results already listed and audited in phase11_powerful_frattini.md; no additional group classification.
boundaries: The uniform theorem is a written proof, not finite extrapolation.
No inference that cyclic TPP plus equality makes an arbitrary product map injective.
No assumption that arbitrary subgroups of a powerful group are powerful.
No full Lean formalization of the new group theorem.
The unrestricted 2-group cyclic TPP problem remains unresolved.
